title: C: physical-resource legal and adaptive accounting
description:
Extend lichen/subsys/lichen/hal/hal_duty.c and include/lichen/duty_cycle.h, charging actual emission boundaries in lichen/subsys/lichen/l2/lora_l2_tx.c. Enforce provisioned legal constraints plus adaptive ceilings using complete frame airtime and physical-frequency/regulatory-group accounts. Control, forwarding, retries and data share applicable restrictions. Index aliases, SF/plan changes or retuning cannot reset or duplicate an allowance.

HPC8 execution policy: Code, test, or schema changes require three independent correctness, security, and robustness reviews; file and fix all findings and re-review. Use independent oracles, never weakened legacy tests or self-generated expected results. Preserve upstream Yggdrasil addressing, radio-owned identity, best-effort custody, baseline SCHC, and the human-only OSCORE/EDHOC security edit bar. External actions, hardware/RF operations, and port access require scoped explicit permission and applicable bench safety checks. Research may conclude no-go; an authorization gate requires affirmative, recorded approval for its actual scope. Dependency closure and decomposition are not permission. No speculative activation, including deferred portability or experimental modes.
design: Preserve and extend the existing monotonic interval-based duty tracker; do not introduce a parallel ledger or retain approximate payload-only charging. zephyr.06 is a reuse alias, not complete-operation proof; exact emitted frame costs come from the existing HAL airtime API. Authority inputs are constraints, not approval, and admission-test leaves are downstream. Preserve baseline SCHC/security, identity ownership, custody and deferred key portability.
acceptance_criteria: Consume vectors.09's independent ledger and authority.02/.05/.06 configured constraints through production C enforcement. Test stricter legal/adaptive ceilings, remote permission expansion, complete-frame charging, all TX classes, aliases, rolling overlap and full-record failure behavior. Reject the second 250 ms emission within 20 s on one frequency under the explicitly configured narrow-FHSS rule. Extend lichen/tests/regional_duty_cycle and L2 integration tests; run host sanitizers/lint and local Linux/heft native checks against the verified west pin, without RF operation.
